scope: Jeeves help-desk backend adaptation: own-ticket customer visibility, scoped agents, internal notes excluded everywhere from customer outputs, finite routing and first-response SLA only. Immutable America/Chicago Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00 calendar with explicit holidays; actual elapsed time in working intervals, including DST. Public authorized agent response stops the clock; pending/internal notes do not. Closing cancels; reopening creates no implicit clock.
excludedScope: Full upstream clone or API compatibility
Application page layout and visual UI composition
Unmeasured production capacity or provider certification
Additional response/resolution clocks and silent deadline recalculation
Inbound email, threading/merge/split, richer SLA, connectors, knowledge base, custom workflows, privacy and reporting remain hook targets.

targets: Escalation lateness p95 <=60s while worker healthy
conditions: Proposed local engineering target; no measurement or upstream capacity claim.
Suggested reference allocation: 8 logical CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, local SSD; record actual host/container/database limits and fixture seed.
Run one and two API instances with shared authority; use open-loop offered load for 600 seconds after warm-up.
Report scheduled/achieved rate, latency including failures, error rate, queue growth, DB connections and resource use; count expected rejections separately.
Unexpected server failures target <0.1%; never lower frozen targets after a failure. Label undersized profiles separately.
Separate barrier contention: 25 attempts for one stock item, 25 stale updates at one revision, and two deadline workers claiming one batch, where applicable.
Separately labeled recovery run restarts one API and one worker and records unavailable time, backlog recovery and invariants; no infinite stress or live data.

capabilities.description: Customer/agent/admin sessions and capabilities; customer cannot self-promote or submit privileged ticket fields
Organizations/groups and agent membership; direct/list access and assignment reject cross-scope or unauthorized users
Create a ticket with initial public article atomically; retry after response loss returns one ticket/conversation entry
Public replies and internal notes with immutable author/time; customer cannot read internal text or its attachment/search/notification projections
Assign/reassign ticket to eligible agents with expectedVersion; stale concurrent assignment and revoked membership are rejected
Ticket transitions and resolution/reopen behavior; failed transitions leave article, deadline and audit state consistent
First-response SLA using snapshotted business calendar; weekends, holidays and timezone boundaries calculate correctly
Durable escalation with cancellation/version checks; worker restart, overdue catch-up and duplicate claim cause one logical escalation
Finite routing conditions/actions with explicit priority and loop prevention; rule matches cannot grant access or create unbounded cascades
Ticket/article attachment lifecycle; inherit article visibility and handle partial bytes/metadata failures without disclosure
Scoped ticket search, cursor pages and audit reads; internal notes remain hidden and stale projections cannot leak a group after revocation
Customer/agent notification preferences, redaction and durable inbox/delivery intent; duplicates/revocation handled consistently
Inbound email channel: authenticated ingest, MIME parsing, bounded attachments, deduplicated source message and sender identity mapping
Conversation threading, ticket merge/split policy and preserved history/visibility; ambiguous message references require an explicit decision
Additional response/resolution clocks, pause/reopen policy and controlled recalculation of existing deadlines
External customer-system connector; field mapping, source authority, retry and reconciliation
Knowledge-base publication and access policy; draft/public separation and article search contracts
Domain-specific custom fields and conditional workflows; typed extension definitions without arbitrary script execution
Customer export/erasure/retention policy with internal-note exclusion and audit/hold decisions
Operational reporting definitions; business-time metrics, scoped aggregates and consistent counting of reopened tickets
